description: This Java class implements a progress listener for file uploads using the Apache Commons FileUpload library. It tracks the progress of file uploads, including bytes read, total content length, and the number of items uploaded.

classes.name: FileUploadProgressListener
classes.description: A listener class that tracks the progress of file upload activities, implementing the ProgressListener interface and Serializable.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates internal counters for bytes read, content length, and items uploaded; marks the start of upload if not already started.

methods.name: getContentLength
methods.description: Returns the total size of the upload content.

methods.name: getBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes read so far.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the number of items processed.

methods.name: hasStarted
methods.description: Returns whether the upload process has started.
